name: kitchen_sdk
_comment_requires: kitchen_sdk >= 1.3.0 requires base_sdk >= 1.43.0 (PlaneHost/Planes/PlaneSpan and FloatingBackPill from the approved plane model — the manager Kitchen screen declares ALL planes per approved frame 34a and folds to the corner back pill on phones per 34c). The composer manifest schema has no machine-readable minimum-version field, so this is the declaration (orders_sdk's convention).

boot_hooks._comment: Registers this SDK's bundled Afrikaans map for its manifest tr_keys into base_sdk's BundledTranslations registry at boot. Backend-served translation rows still win; the map is only the offline/unseeded fallback consulted before the humanized-key fallback. Requires a base_sdk with bundled_translations.dart.

manager._comment: The manager KITCHEN screen (approved frames 34a-34d, Ray 2026-08-29 13:06Z/13:53Z): the paas_pos KitchenPage behaviour as a manager destination in the dark base design. KitchenHomePage installs to lib/presentation/pages/kitchen/kitchen_page.dart - the exact path merchants_sdk's main_page.dart shell imports (>= 1.14.0 mounts the Kitchen tab); it is tab-hosted, so it declares no route (orders_sdk's OrdersHomePage contract). All machinery is package code under lib/src/manager/ (queue notifier, dish-line state machine, flip clock, plane flow) - declaring this manager block also keeps that folder alive through sdk_composer.py's strip_unused_role_folders. Data rides kitchen's own frappe module (api.cook.get_kitchen_orders / api.cook.update_kitchen_dish_status) plus the existing api.seller_order.update_seller_order_status for order-level transitions. Requires .rokct/config/app_type = manager.
manager._comment_tr_keys: New wire keys for the kitchen screen only - checked against base_sdk's hand-written keys (back/all/search/done/pending-adjacent live there or in orders_sdk's manager block: accepted/cooking/ready/canceled/pending/view_more/no_orders/dine_in are orders_sdk's declarations, pickup/delivery/order/are_you_sure/cancel_order are base's own) and against every other commerce manifest - no collision. The dish-line labels Pending/Preparing/Done are the approved 34d cook-facing renames; order-level pills keep the POS words.

_comment_tr_keys: Declared here rather than hand-written into base_sdk because only this SDK uses them - checked against base_sdk's 532 hand-written keys and against paas_driver's 122 app-local new keys, no collision either way. Keys needed by two or more SDKs belong hand-written in base_sdk instead, since the installer resolves a double declaration by silently keeping whichever it sees first.
